name: Facet
text:
Ship a real API endpoint behind a feature flag tonight, not a thin stub.

This gives us real network behavior to test against, exposing actual latency and error patterns. The trade-off is higher upfront effort, but we avoid debugging fake responses later when real data behaves differently.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A real API endpoint tonight risks burning dev hours on infrastructure we’ll scrap tomorrow—real network behavior isn’t worth real downtime if the interface isn’t settled. Ship a thin live stub with mocked latency and error injection instead; we test real behavior without the cost. Settle it: show me the stub’s latency/error model matches the real API spec, or we pivot to the stub tonight.
